title: Sanitary Tee on Horizontal Runs
description: Installing a standard sanitary tee on a horizontal drain line is a frequent plumbing mistake and code violation. Sanitary tees feature a short throat radius designed specifically for vertical-to-horizontal flow transitions or vent piping connections. When used horizontally, waste solids lack the smooth directional sweep needed to maintain momentum, leading to splashing, debris accumulation, and frequent blockages. Instead, a combination wye and 1/8 bend or a long-turn tee-wye should always be installed on horizontal branch lines. Proper fitting selection maintains flow velocity and prevents recurring drainage service calls.
